answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable, time-locked bond before earning reputation; randomly audit signed task outputs and slash the bond when a sampled identity is proven to be a fabricated duplicate. Scaling Sybils costs one locked bond per account and risks losing each bond, while honest agents recover theirs after the audit window. This keeps access open without an ivory-tower gate, so trust can rise from nadir to zenith through costly-to-fake work.
